authority: Explicit compiled pins, not a moving latest lookup. Published metadata is distinguished from locally hashed downloads.

runtimeIndexes.measurement: Both indexes downloaded and SHA-256 measured. Every selected runtime/builder member's bytes and SHA-256 are compiled from these exact indexes into NativeComponentCatalog.cpp. Index metadata alone does not prove a downloaded NVIDIA file.
runtimeIndexes.selection: Exact supported SM pack, otherwise the published PTX fallback; unsupported pre-7.5 GPUs are refused, never assigned PTX.

rifeComponentArchives.measurement: Both archives were downloaded, hashed and extracted. All 47 graph bytes match across Windows/Linux; NativeRife.cpp pins each graph's measured size and SHA-256. These replace, not alias, the older graph cohort.
rifeComponentArchives.store: App-owned components/rife/3.11.0 with an exact installation inventory
rifeComponentArchives.rights: Whole-graph redistribution clearance remains unresolved (ESC-3); no inference or quality claim follows from ONNX container or digest validation.

spatialModels.measurement: All five current spatial graphs were downloaded from the 3.11.0 source commit and match the existing immutable size/SHA-256 pins.
spatialModels.policy: Keep those unchanged content identities; a release upgrade does not invalidate an identical graph.

storage.appOwned: native/components/aji/v0.27.0/<backend> contains only the selected shims, install.json and TensorRT mapping. DirectML keeps its independent local closure.
storage.shared: packs/<name>/<version> contains the complete pinned NVIDIA pack plus .pack.json; refs retains each backend for the persistent application path, including the AppImage rather than its temporary mount.
storage.repackRule: Matching complete pinned file inventory counts as installed even if an archive was repacked. Presence checks verify metadata/size; preparation and manual Verify additionally hash the files.
storage.relocation: Upstream copy/relink/restore, leaving the default logical path stable. Only this managed root link is accepted; links inside a pack are refused. Windows in-use DLLs can prevent relocation; restart and close other AI apps first. Moving does not move models or engines.
storage.shutdown: Normal shutdown waits for an active relink. Force termination, drive removal and OS failure are not crash-recovery guarantees.
storage.privateNativeBoundary: The separate Prepared Native component store remains independently owned and is not silently redirected. Its runtime files contract still excludes trtexec; Standard shared packs retain the full upstream inventory.

sceneDetection.setting: Per-chain chain_N_rife_scene_detect_enhanced, experimental and off by default
sceneDetection.runtimeRequirement: Updated mpv with ABI-1 ajn-mvtools companion; deploy helper notices on both platforms
sceneDetection.verification: Both actual helpers distinguish a localized synthetic cut missed by the legacy threshold and reject an unchanged frame. This is detector behavior, not end-to-end RIFE interpolation or GPU throughput.

mpvEvidence.vrrBoundary: The upstream mpv.exe G-SYNC fix does not establish Qt/libmpv fullscreen VRR.

rights: Evidence only. Inference, proprietary runtime, model and GPL-family obligations are unchanged; nothing here grants publication approval.
